name: Elite Sonic Rifle

text: Top-tier cryo sidearm. Capable of flash-freezing heavily armored targets with a single shot.

name: Environmental Sealing Gear
text: Portable environment kit with sealed helmet providing 1 hour of breathable atmosphere. Protects against vacuum and toxic environments.

name: Everyday Clothing
text: Standard, unremarkable clothing appropriate for everyday wear. Includes a complete outfit for the local culture.

name: Field Rations (1 week)
text: One week of compact, nutritionally complete field rations in sealed packaging. Unpalatable but effective at preventing the starving condition.

name: Flashlight
text: Hand-held illumination device creating a 60-foot cone of normal light. Runs 24 hours per charge on a standard battery.

name: Fortification Talisman
text: Affixed to armor. When you would take a critical hit, you can activate this talisman as a reaction to make it a normal hit instead. The talisman is then consumed.

name: Frag Grenade Mk 1
text: Explodes in a 10-foot burst dealing 1d6 piercing damage (Reflex half). Creatures adjacent to the burst also take 1 splash piercing damage. Thrown using the Area Fire action at 70 feet.

name: Frag Grenade Mk 2
text: Larger burst radius and more shrapnel. Each creature in a 15-foot burst takes 2d6 piercing damage (Reflex half).

name: Gill Sheath
text: Grafted gill membranes along your neck. You can breathe underwater indefinitely and suffer no penalties for being submerged. Occupies your throat system.

name: Grappling Hook
text: Multi-tined hook attached to 50 feet of reinforced cable. Can anchor to ledges or structures, supporting up to 10 bulk of weight.

name: Horacalcum (Standard-grade Object)
text: An exceedingly rare skymetal that warps time around it. Equipment forged of horacalcum can manipulate speed and reaction, granting fleeting glimpses of the near future.

name: Incendiary Grenade Mk 1
text: Spreads burning thermite gel in a 10-foot burst dealing 1d6 fire damage (Reflex half) and leaving the area burning for 1 round.

name: Infrared Sensors
text: Replacement ocular implants tuned to the infrared spectrum. You gain darkvision. Occupies your eyes system (replaces both eyes).

name: Magitech Conduit
text: Arcane circuitry woven through your nervous system channels raw magic. You gain a +1 item bonus to spell attack rolls and to spell DCs. Occupies your spinal column system. Magitech augmentations both detect as magical and respond to technology.

name: Mantle of the Drifting Dark
text: A shadow-woven cloak. While invested, you gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks, and you can activate it to gain concealment until the start of your next turn.

name: Mk 1 Serum of Healing
text: A magically enhanced healing serum. When drunk as an Interact action, it restores 1d8 HP. Can be administered to an adjacent creature.

name: Mk 2 Serum of Healing
text: A more potent healing serum. When drunk as an Interact action, it restores 3d8 HP. Can be administered to an adjacent creature.

name: Noqual (Standard-grade Object)
text: A green, crystalline skymetal that resists magic. Armor of noqual bolsters saving throws against magic, though it interferes with the wearer's own spellcasting.
